new_source_facts.text:
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct CommitReceipt {
    pub target_path: String,
    pub previous_digest: Option<String>,
    pub committed_digest: String,
    pub transaction_id: String,
}
new_source_facts.meaning: 四欄單檔 CommitReceipt：沒有 document/session/revision/semantic digest、Held issuer、root-transfer或ACK欄位
FileWriteLease read/replace 單檔輸出埠，不定義 M05 root-transfer 或 M04 ACK
成功分支先核對發布 bytes 與 journal，再構造四欄 receipt；raw byte digest 不等 document semantic digest
目前 scene save helper 透過 FileSystemPort.write_atomic 回傳 path；此函式未呼叫 FileCommitPort/root-transfer/semantic ACK
capture 為 immutable document/session/revision/content；formal ACK 接收 revision+digest 並更新 formal_baseline
recovery ACK 更新 snapshot_baseline，與 formal baseline 分離
ACK 校驗 editable/digest/future revision/baseline monotonic；dirty 比較 semantic digest
M05-S1純策略資料：owner-supplied roots/Retain/Eligible，並非 authenticated Held receipt
missing/unknown/stale root 導致保留；Eligible 僅回 identity，不是 root transfer、cleanup lease 或刪除授權
